Create a fashion editorial photograph in the style of environmental portrait photography. Color and mood: magenta and cyan neon palette, playful sweet cosplay mood; keep the palette, emotional tone, and world context coherent with the subject and setting. Texture, format, and finish: feline reflective eyes and whisker-shadow skin marks, subtle palm pads and claw-like nails blended into otherwise human hands, fur patch blended into skin texture, minimal no-makeup look, frilled apron maid-cafe costume, square 1:1 aspect ratio, photorealistic and natural as if truly photographed; render skin, hair, fabric, metal, glass, makeup, and accessories with accurate material detail. Constraints: no text or watermark. Prioritize a specific, image-ready photographic result over a vague style summary.
